item.title: Australia Day 2026 in Geraldton: Foreshore fun, peaceful protest, new citizens and awards mark public holiday
item.description: The Geraldton foreshore was a hive of activity on Monday, packed with families and friends celebrating Australia Day on a mild summer’s day as new citizens were welcomed and a peaceful protest was staged.

item.title: Geraldton-based and filmed Invisible Boys nominated for two AACTA Awards, for best mini-series and editing
item.description: Geraldton-based and filmed TV series Invisible Boys will be vying for a couple of gongs at the 2026 AACTA Awards early next month.

item.title: Rising volleyball star Amarliah Rangi eyes off 2032 Brisbane Olympics after national training squad selection
item.description: One Geraldton volleyball player has her sights set on a possible Olympics appearance after being selected in the national indoor volleyball program based in Canberra.

item.title: Snapshot in Time: Aerial image of central Geraldton in 1960s shows town before many developments
item.description: This late 1960s aerial view of central Geraldton was taken from a Royal Navy helicopter being flown from a visiting warship.

item.title: Works to install changing rooms, storage facility on Geraldton Foreshore to start this week
item.description: Foreshore swimmers will be pleased to know that works to install new changing rooms and a storage facility adjacent to the Rubik’s Cube toilets are set to start this week.

item.title: Consumer Watch with Candice Evans: Getting to the bottom of material facts before you buy a home
item.description: Buying a home is a big decision often tied to a lot of emotion. Beyond what you can see at the home open, there may be things about the property that aren’t so obvious and could influence your decision to buy.

item.title: Geraldton women’s country week title defence over following three losses
item.description: Geraldton’s A-section title defence is over following three losses in the women’s country week tournament in Peel last weekend.

item.title: Geraldton relegated from A-section in men’s country week tournament following winless campaign
item.description: A winless campaign from Geraldton has seen its A-section side relegated for next year’s men’s country week cricket tournament less than 12 months after that incredible A-section title win in 2025.

item.title: Geraldton Water Polo Association round 13: B52’s flex muscles after delivering a flawless weekend in the pool
item.description: B52’s deliver a perfect round 13 in the pool, completing a clean sweep across all grades, as a club stalwart brought up the 300-game milestone.

item.title: New mural on North West Coastal Highway by artist Alex Sugar brings health message to Geraldton
item.description: Driving down the North West Coastal Highway has gotten a bit brighter, with a new mural promoting youth Indigenous health painted over the weekend.
